title: Quidnunc

inlines.v: QUID'NUNC, noun [Latin what now.] One who is curious to know every thing that passes; one who knows or pretends to know all occurrences. Quid pro quo, [Latin] in law, an equivalent; something given or done for another thing; mutual consideration and performance.
